tasks.name: Adding Products to Cart
tasks.description: User wants to add various products to their shopping cart for purchase.

steps.description: Navigate to the website homepage.
Browse or search for a specific product.
Click on the product to view its details.
Choose any necessary options (size, color, quantity).
Click the 'Add to Cart' button for the desired product.
Repeat steps 2-5 for additional products.

tasks.name: Creating an Account
tasks.description: User wants to create a new account to track orders and save wish lists.

steps.description: Navigate to the website homepage.
Click on 'Create an Account' link.
Fill out the registration form with personal information.
Submit the form.
Confirm the account creation through an email verification link.

tasks.name: Searching for Products
tasks.description: User wants to find products by keyword search.

steps.description: Navigate to the website homepage.
Locate the search bar.
Type a keyword or product name into the search bar.
Press Enter or click the search button.
Browse the search results.

tasks.name: Viewing Product Details
tasks.description: User wants to view detailed information about a product, including price, ratings, and availability.

steps.description: Navigate to the website homepage or search for a specific product.
Click on the product from the search results or homepage showcase.
Review the product details on the product page.

tasks.name: Checking Out
tasks.description: User wants to complete their purchase by checking out the items in their shopping cart.

steps.description: Ensure you are signed into your account.
Navigate to 'My Cart' by clicking on the cart icon.
Review the items in your cart and make any necessary adjustments (quantity, remove items).
Click the 'Checkout' button.
Enter shipping and payment information.
Review the order summary.
Confirm the order.

tasks.name: Adding Products to Wish List
tasks.description: User wants to save products to a wish list for future purchase consideration.

steps.description: Navigate to the website and sign into your account.
Search or browse for a product.
On the product page, click the 'Add to Wish List' button.
Repeat steps 2-3 for additional products.
